brand.title: AGILIX brand identity
brand.intro: A light, confident identity for a platform about steady progress. Two stacked up-chevrons form an abstract “A”: one sprint after another, each step building on the last.
brand.logo.bilingual: Bilingual lockup: AGILIX with the Arabic wordmark
brand.name.rule: The name is always AGILIX in Latin letters, in every language. The Arabic wordmark sits beside it as a companion and never replaces it. Its coral dots echo the dots of the two i's.
brand.logo.dark: Reversed logo, on Ink and photos
brand.logo.mark: App icon & favicon: legible down to 16 px
brand.concept.1.title: Progress, sprint by sprint
brand.concept.1.text: The stacked chevrons point upward: agile learning moves forward in short, steady iterations.
brand.concept.2.title: The learner's next step
brand.concept.2.text: The coral chevron is the step you're taking now. The coral dots in the wordmark repeat it.
brand.concept.3.title: Friendly and app-ready
brand.concept.3.text: A rounded tile with a blue-to-teal gradient that works as an app icon, avatar and favicon.
brand.s.colorText: Blue leads, Teal supports, Coral highlights, Ink grounds. Click a colour to copy its code.
brand.do.1: Leave clear space around the logo equal to the height of the coral chevron.
brand.do.2: Use the full logo at 96 px wide or more, and the mark alone below that.
brand.do.3: Use the reversed logo on Ink or dark photos.
brand.dont.1: Recolour, stretch, rotate or outline the logo.
brand.dont.2: Use Coral for large surfaces or long text.
brand.dont.3: Place the logo on busy or low-contrast backgrounds.

studio.title: AGILIX Studio
studio.lead: Create your platform's content with AI for free: chat to write lessons and quizzes, images for your courses, and videos made right in your browser.
studio.gate.title: Enter the studio
studio.gate.text: This page is for the platform owner. Enter the studio password you set in Vercel.
studio.gate.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
studio.gate.offline: Can't reach the studio server. Make sure the api folder is deployed with the site on Vercel and that you open the site from its web address, not a local file.
studio.setup.title: The studio needs one setup step
studio.setup.text: Add these variables in Vercel → your project → Settings → Environment Variables, then redeploy.
studio.setup.password: The studio password, at least 12 characters. Keep it to yourself.
studio.setup.account: Your free Cloudflare account id: Cloudflare dashboard → Workers AI → Use REST API → Account ID.
studio.setup.token: On the same page: Create a Workers AI API Token, then copy it.
studio.setup.free: Everything is free: a free Cloudflare account gives you a daily allowance that renews and asks for no credit card. The local model and the video maker need no key at all.
studio.engine.label: Writing engine
studio.engine.cloudHint: {model} on Cloudflare. A free daily allowance that renews at 00:00 UTC.

studio.local.ready: The local model is ready. Write as much as you like.
studio.local.size: Downloads once (about {gb} GB), then stays on this device. Needs a WebGPU browser (Chrome or Edge) and about {vram} GB of graphics memory.
studio.local.firstTime: First time only; it resumes if interrupted.
studio.local.noGpu: This browser or device doesn't support WebGPU. Use a recent Chrome or Edge on a computer, or the free cloud.
studio.local.noMemory: This device doesn't have enough memory for that model. Choose a lighter one.
